name: Aloo Tomato Curry
description: A comforting potato and tomato curry made with everyday ingredients.
steps: Wash, peel and chop the potatoes.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onion.
Add tomatoes, salt and turmeric. Cook until soft.
Add potatoes and a little water.
Cover and cook until the potatoes are tender.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: A quick and delicious way to use leftover rice and vegetables.
steps: Cook rice beforehand or use leftover rice.
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onion.
Add available vegetables and cook until slightly tender.
Add rice, salt and pepper.
Mix well and stir-fry for a few minutes.

name: Masala Omelette
description: A quick, protein-rich breakfast with onions and tomatoes.
steps: Beat eggs in a bowl.
Add chopped onion, tomato, salt and chilli.
Heat oil in a pan.
Pour in the egg mixture.
Cook both sides until completely set.

name: Simple Tomato Rice
description: A tangy rice dish made with tomatoes and simple spices.
steps: Cook rice and keep it aside.
Sauté chopped onion in a pan.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt and turmeric.
Cook until the tomatoes become soft.
Mix in the cooked rice and serve warm.

name: Besan Chilla
description: A savoury gram-flour pancake that is simple and filling.
steps: Add besan to a bowl and gradually mix in water.
Add chopped onion, tomato and salt.
Make a smooth, pourable batter.
Heat a lightly oiled pan.
Spread the batter and cook both sides until golden.

name: Garlic Potato Stir Fry
description: Crispy, seasoned potatoes for a quick side dish.
steps: Cut potatoes into small cubes.
Heat oil in a pan and add chopped garlic.
Add potatoes, salt and chilli.
Cook on medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Cook until golden and tender.

name: Vegetable Poha
description: A light Indian breakfast using flattened rice and vegetables.
steps: Rinse poha briefly and drain.
Heat oil and sauté onion.
Add potato and peas and cook until tender.
Add poha, salt and turmeric.
Mix gently and cook for a few minutes.

name: Paneer Bhurji
description: A protein-rich Indian dish made with crumbled paneer.
steps: Crumble paneer into small pieces.
Heat oil and sauté chopped onion.
Add tomatoes, salt and turmeric.
Cook until soft, then add paneer.
Mix and cook for a few minutes.
